## The heuristic

**Escalate on blast radius and irreversibility, not on ticket volume.**


_Why:_ Volume is the metric the queue surfaces naturally, so loud cosmetic faults outrank quiet destructive ones by default. A single silent data-corruption report outranks a wave of rendering complaints, and nothing in the tooling will tell you that.
